mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at overcast skies with a warm temperature of 90 degrees, feeling like 92 degrees, near the Verona Public Library.

The City of Verona has welcomed a new public art piece to Century School Park, located at the corner of Art House 360. Named Tai Chi Animal Frolics, the seven-foot-tall sculpture was carved from a reclaimed ash tree by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland. The project was donated by resident Gerri Gurman, and future plans include native landscaping and multilingual educational signs.

There is plenty happening in the area! Today, you can check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, join Pizza and a Pitcher night at Lake Lou-ee, or play trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, Hop Haus is hosting trivia tomorrow, and you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard this Friday.

In the latest police weekly recap, on Sunday, August 30th, officers responded to a collision between a vehicle and a fifteen-year-old bicyclist on East Verona Avenue. Thankfully, the young cyclist was not injured, though his bicycle was damaged, and the driver was cited for failing to yield.

To wrap things up, the Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM. You can stop by to grab a scoop of today's delicious flavor, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, or look forward to tomorrow's flavor, Snickers Swirl, starting at 10 AM.
